eyebrow: Honoring the Fallen, One Name at a Time
title: Remembering Those Who Gave Everything

intro.title: We Exist to Honor the Brave
intro.text: For more than 5 years, the Flag to Remember has traveled across the country in honor of our fallen.

history.title: About & History
history.text: By transforming name tapes into memorial flags, we give families and communities a way to remember, reflect, and continue conversations about service and sacrifice.

video.title: Join the Mission: Remember Through the Flag

founder.name: Anthony Peterson
paragraphs: Anthony’s mission began with a single flag. A veteran himself, he lost friends to combat and suicide and wanted a way to carry their memories with him. That first flag became a symbol—then a movement.
Through Flag to Remember, Anthony has dedicated his life to ensuring no fallen hero is forgotten, bringing families and communities together through remembrance and reflection.

image.alt: Anthony Peterson, founder of Flag to Remember, in a television interview.

vision.text: Our vision is to bring hundreds of flags across the country, each carrying the names of our fallen. Every name represents a life lived, a story worth telling, and a legacy that deserves to endure.

teamIntro: The Flag to Remember Team brings heartfelt dedication, visionary passion, and an unwavering commitment to honoring our nation’s heroes.

thanks.title: Thank You
thanks.text: We couldn’t do it without your support.
